name: Default
shortDescription: Relational database and application server that runs your logic as modules inside the database and syncs state to clients over WebSockets.

alerts.message: The whole HTTP API is public: anyone who can reach the URL can obtain an identity and publish databases. Upstream recommends restricting publishing on internet-facing servers.
There is no web interface. Register the server with the CLI (spacetime server add --url https://<your-domain> <name>) and publish modules from your machine.
